verified_facts.text: The resort spans 39 acres along Santa Maria Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spanning 39 acres along the gentle azure waters of Santa Maria Bay, Montage Los Cabos resort

verified_facts.text: The hotel is set on the Golden Corridor, an undeveloped stretch between the hotel zones of Cabo San Lucas and San Jose del Cabo.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is set on the Golden Corridor, an undeveloped stretch between the hotel zones of Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo.

verified_facts.text: The city centers of both Cabo San Lucas and San Jose del Cabo are each about a 20-minute taxi ride away.
verified_facts.excerpt: the city centers of both Cabos are each a 20-minute taxi ride away

verified_facts.text: The hotel faces the calm Santa Maria Bay, one of the rare beaches in Cabo without breaking waves where you can wade in and swim.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cabo where there aren't crazy breaking waves and wily currents, where you can just wade right in and go for a swim

verified_facts.text: The landscaping uses native and drought-tolerant plants such as rock figs, agave and saguaro instead of green lawns.
